brand.name: Leewaysoftech
brand.tagline: a software development company building web, mobile, and enterprise solutions
brand.signature: Leewaysoftech — Building software that moves business forward.

intents.name: technologies
intents.answer:
• Here's the stack we build with:
• *Frontend:* React, Angular and Vue
• *Backend:* Node.js, Python (Django/Flask), PHP and .NET
• *Mobile:* Flutter, React Native and native iOS/Android
• *Cloud & DevOps:* AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines
• *Databases:* PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and Redis
• Tell us what you're building and we'll match the right stack for it.

intents.name: projects
intents.answer:
• A snapshot of the work we deliver:
• *Web platforms:* e-commerce stores, customer portals and internal systems
• *Mobile apps:* customer and field-force apps for iOS and Android
• *Enterprise:* CRM/ERP integrations, workflow automation and analytics dashboards
• *Industries:* retail, healthcare, finance, logistics and education
• We share client names and detailed case studies only with their written permission — our team can walk you through relevant examples on a call.

intents.name: careers
intents.answer:
• We're always glad to hear from good people:
• *Roles we hire for:* frontend, backend and mobile developers, QA engineers, DevOps and UI/UX designers
• *Internships:* available for final-year students and fresh graduates
• *How to apply:* send your CV to info@leewaysoftech.com with the role in the subject line
• Shortlisted candidates hear from us within a few working days.

intents.name: benefits
intents.answer:
• Why teams choose to work with us:
• *Dedicated project manager* as your single point of contact
• *Agile delivery* in two-week sprints with regular demos
• *Transparent reporting* — you always know where things stand
• *Post-launch support and maintenance* packages
• *Your IP stays yours* — full code and documentation handover
• *Fixed-price or dedicated-team* engagement models, NDA on request
